issue_context.title: Crash pressing drives after being in tags
issue_context.body:
### Description

Going into one of the tags and then pressing on the drives tab crashes Files.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Press on one of the tags
2. Press on the drives main

### Files Version

Version: 2.3.65.0 OS Version: 10.0.22000.1281

### Windows Version

Microsoft Windows 11 Pro 10.0.22000 Build 22000

### Relevant Assets/Logs

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/10194076/debug.log)
comments: Is this not an issue in the stable version?
now it happens in the new stable version too

review_comments: Isn't this already checked on line 1077?

It is not, it's actually part of a bigger condition : 
`(string.IsNullOrEmpty(navigationPath) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(FilesystemViewModel?.WorkingDirectory) || navigationPath.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar).Equals(FilesystemViewModel.WorkingDirectory.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))`
